verdict.rationale: WezTerm documents a Searchable Scrollback feature with Ctrl-Shift-F search mode and keyboard navigation (Shift-PageUp/PageDown, mouse wheel), directly matching the story of quickly searching and jumping between matches; Quick Select mode further complements this for jumping to specific text patterns. Community evidence corroborates related scrollback tooling (get-text dump) though no direct hands-on account of search-and-jump-between-matches UX specifically. Missing for 10: independent hands-on account of the search-mode match-navigation experience (e.g., keybindings for next/prev match) and any friction/limitations reported by users.
